name: Call and answer: positioned sound and glow pulse
body: One input (call). She answers with a sound placed in 3D (PlayAt) and a pulse of her glow that shows through crowds and walls. How fast, how loud and how bright the answer is comes from the chapter mood. A placeholder generated sound stands in until Cinder; the sound name is one constant so it can be swapped.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: Pressing call plays an answer from her position
Chapter 5 and the blue-door ghost can answer differently or not at all
